# The files Payload writes in each node project of a Payload module: the types and the database schema its CLI
# generates from the configuration, and the admin and API glue under src/app/(payload), which create-payload-app
# scaffolds with the header "THIS FILE WAS GENERATED AUTOMATICALLY BY PAYLOAD. DO NOT MODIFY IT" and whose import
# map the CLI regenerates. Agents may not edit them; payload-generated regenerates the types and the import map
# and fails on drift.
src/payload-types.ts	NODE_PROJECT
src/payload-generated-schema.ts	NODE_PROJECT
src/app/(payload)/**	NODE_PROJECT
